svg.title: Llaminar published-image benchmarks
svg.desc: Both ISA images passed full HTTP E2E. Source 557f0f97d15d447850b77b7ce4e91bb0663331b3. Grouped by model size. Exact prefill and decode medians in tokens per second. Each cell and phase is normalized to its own AVX512 result at 100%; bar lengths do not compare different cells.
svg.text: Full HTTP E2E passed · warmed production inference · median of measured requests
AVX512 = 100% within each cell and phase · Compare ISA lanes within a row, not bar lengths between rows.
MODEL / TOPOLOGY / CONTEXT CAPACITY / ACTUAL PROMPT
Phase-specific evidence, not full-image certification. See accompanying JSON for exact policies, image digests, hardware and samples.
